f3_program: collection("colton.dolphin_stickers", "dolphin_sticker", "colton", source("72 dolphin stickers"))
observe(at("colton.dolphin_stickers.count", "initial"), 72, "count", source("Colton had 72 dolphin stickers"))
collection("colton.first_friend_group", "friend", "colton", source("3 friends"))
observe(at("colton.first_friend_group.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("3 friends"))
observe(at("colton.gifts.first_friend_group.each.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("4 stickers each"))

product_relation(at("colton.gifts.first_friend_group.total.count", "current"), at("colton.gifts.first_friend_group.each.count", "current"), at("colton.first_friend_group.count", "current"), source("4 stickers each to 3 friends"))

transfer("give_first_friend_group", "colton", at("colton.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("colton.first_friend_group.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("colton.gifts.first_friend_group.total.count", "current"), source("He gave 4 stickers each to 3 friends"))
offset(at("colton.gifts.mandy.count", "current"), event_field("give_first_friend_group", "quantity"), 2, "count", source("2 more than he gave his three friends total"))

transfer("give_mandy", "colton", at("colton.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("mandy.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("colton.gifts.mandy.count", "current"), source("He also gave his friend Mandy 2 more than he gave his three friends total"))
offset(at("colton.gifts.justin.count", "current"), event_field("give_mandy", "quantity"), -10, "count", source("10 less than Mandy"))

transfer("give_justin", "colton", at("colton.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("justin.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("colton.gifts.justin.count", "current"), source("he gave Justin 10 less than Mandy"))
query("remaining_count", "colton.dolphin_stickers", "current")
observe(at("nigella.base_salary", "month"), 3000, "dollar", source("base salary of $3,000 a month"))

member("nigella.sold_houses", "nigella.sold_houses.house_b", source("House B costs three times as much as House A"))

percent_of(at("nigella.sold_houses.house_b.commission", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.house_b.cost", "month"), 2, source("2% commission on every house she sells"))
percent_of(at("nigella.sold_houses.house_c.commission", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.house_c.cost", "month"), 2, source("2% commission on every house she sells"))

sum_relation(at("nigella.sold_houses.commission.total", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.house_a.commission", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.house_b.commission", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.house_c.commission", "month"), source("a 2% commission on every house she sells. One month, Nigella sells 3 houses"))

sum_relation(at("nigella.earnings.total", "month"), at("nigella.base_salary", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.commission.total", "month"), source("earns a base salary of $3,000 a month plus a 2% commission on every house she sells"))
observe(at("nigella.earnings.total", "month"), 8000, "dollar", source("earns $8,000 total"))
multiple(at("nigella.sold_houses.house_b.cost", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.house_a.cost", "month"), 3, source("House B costs three times as much as House A"))
offset(at("nigella.sold_houses.house_c.cost", "month"), scale(at("nigella.sold_houses.house_a.cost", "month"), 2), -110000, "dollar", source("House C cost twice as much as House A minus $110,000"))
query("value", at("nigella.sold_houses.house_a.cost", "month"))

member("john.daily_meals", "john.daily_meals.dinner", source("His dinner is twice as many calories as lunch"))
multiple(at("john.daily_meals.dinner.calories", "day"), at("john.daily_meals.lunch.calories", "day"), 2, source("His dinner is twice as many calories as lunch"))

sum_relation(at("john.daily_meals.calories.total", "day"), at("john.daily_meals.breakfast.calories", "day"), at("john.daily_meals.lunch.calories", "day"), at("john.daily_meals.dinner.calories", "day"), source("John eats 3 meals a day. collection("kylie.class.students", "student", "kylie.class", source("students in Kylie's class"))
observe(at("kylie.class.students.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("The number of students in Kylie's class is 50"))

collection("kylie.class.test_score_groups", "student_group", "kylie.class.students", source("ten students scored 90 marks, 15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students, and the rest scored 60 marks each"))
member("kylie.class.test_score_groups", "kylie.class.test_score_groups.first", source("ten students scored 90 marks"))
member("kylie.class.test_score_groups", "kylie.class.test_score_groups.second", source("15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students"))
member("kylie.class.test_score_groups", "kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining", source("the rest scored 60 marks each"))

partition("kylie.class.test_score_groups", at("kylie.class.students.count", "current"), source("ten students scored 90 marks, 15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students, and the rest scored 60 marks each"))
observe(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.students.count", "particular_test"), 10, "count", source("ten students scored 90 marks"))
observe(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.score", "particular_test"), 90, "mark", source("ten students scored 90 marks"))
observe(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.students.count", "particular_test"), 15, "count", source("15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students"))

offset(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.score", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.score", "particular_test"), -10, "mark", source("15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students"))
observe(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining.score", "particular_test"), 60, "mark", source("the rest scored 60 marks each"))

sum_relation(at("kylie.class.students.count", "current"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.students.count", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.students.count", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining.students.count", "particular_test"), source("ten students scored 90 marks, 15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students, and the rest scored 60 marks each"))

product_relation(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.marks.total", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.students.count", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.score", "particular_test"), source("ten students scored 90 marks"))

product_relation(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.marks.total", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.students.count", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.score", "particular_test"), source("15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students"))

product_relation(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining.marks.total", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining.students.count", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining.score", "particular_test"), source("the rest scored 60 marks each"))

sum_relation(at("kylie.class.test_marks.total", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.marks.total", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.marks.total", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining.marks.total", "particular_test"), source("ten students scored 90 marks, 15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students, and the rest scored 60 marks each"))

quotient_relation(at("kylie.class.students.test_score.mean", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_marks.total", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.students.count", "current"), source("average marks for the whole class"))
query("value", at("kylie.class.students.test_score.mean", "particular_test"))
